contact.name: Pam Geyer
contact.evidence_quote: Pam Geyer ... Born and raised outside of Pittsburgh, PA, Pam has called the Outer Banks home since 2004. Working at Twiddy since 2009, her background in hospitality and guest services assisted her with a smooth transition to her current role, Owner Services Manager. Pam loves to travel so when she's not at work you can find her jet-setting around the world or relaxing with a good book in Ocracoke.
